# 2 Kings 19 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 19 (37 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.3 — "birth-opening" vs. "point of birth" vs. "woman in labor"
- **EMET:** "birth-opening [mashber]" / **LOGOS:** "point of birth" / **PNEUMA:** "woman in labor who has no strength"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "point of birth" — preserves the metaphor without over-expanding or being too clinical.

---

## V.6 — "servants" vs. "underlings"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "servants" / **PNEUMA:** "underlings"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "servants" — *na'ar* is neutral; "underlings" imports a dismissive tone not in the Hebrew.

---

## V.21 — Poetry formatting (prose vs. verse)
- **EMET:** prose format / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** indented poetry
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Indented poetry — vv.21-28 are clearly poetic oracle.

---

## V.28 — "lips" vs. "mouth"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "bit in your lips" / **PNEUMA:** "bit in your mouth"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "lips" — Hebrew specifies *sefatayim* (lips), not *peh* (mouth).

---

## V.31 — "zeal" vs. "passionate commitment"; "hosts" vs. "Armies"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "zeal of the LORD of hosts" / **PNEUMA:** "passionate commitment of the LORD of Armies"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "zeal of the LORD of hosts" — preserves the traditional formulaic phrasing.

---
*— SOPHIA*
